# Black marble

Type: Material | Internal ID: BlackMarble | Source: Giant Remains, and various structures in the, Mistlands, biome | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Black marble is black hard stone found in the Mistlands.

## Availability

Black marble can mainly be mined from Giant Remains in the Mistlands, or harvested in lesser quantities from destroying (either by mining or deconstructing using a Stonecutter) Dvergr-built structures. Black marble requires a Black metal pickaxe to mine. Alternatively, Black marble may be obtained without mining as an uncommon drop from Dvergr rogues and Dvergr mages, and by destroying certain features which spawn in Infested Mines or the Infested Citadel.
Like regular stone, Black marble can be taken through portals.

### Crafting

• Ceramic plate
